sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's accelerating digital economy, driven by rising internet penetration and e-commerce adoption, creates durable demand for local tech infrastructure and payment platforms.
Global semiconductor reshoring and AI capex cycles benefit Indonesian-linked chip assembly and testing firms, especially those tied to Taiwan and Korean supply chains.
Government push for domestic cloud and data center localization provides long-term tailwinds for Indonesian tech service providers, reducing reliance on foreign infrastructure.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech sector shows mixed signals with local underperformance vs US peers, but selective movers like TRON (+23.81%) and GPSO (+15.92%) indicate strong idiosyncratic catalysts. Focus on digital infrastructure plays and semiconductor supply chain beneficiaries, as structural demand from AI and cloud adoption remains intact despite near-term volatility.

themes: Indonesia's downstream nickel processing mandate continues to capture higher value-added production, insulating integrated producers from raw ore price volatility and attracting foreign direct investm
Coal demand from domestic power plants and India/China infrastructure spending provides a durable floor for Indonesian thermal coal exporters, despite global decarbonization headwinds.
Regulatory certainty under the new government's energy policy, including DMO requirements and royalty frameworks, supports stable margins for large-cap miners with long-term offtake agreements.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's mining & energy sector outperformed today (+1.25% ID vs -0.46% US), driven by broad-based gains in coal and nickel names. ALKA surged 12.95% on speculation of new coal supply contracts, while DEWA and DSSA rallied on nickel price support from China stimulus. Maintain overweight on select coal exporters with cost advantages and nickel producers with downstream integration, as structural demand from EV and infrastructure remains intact.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's mandated biodiesel blending (B35) and upcoming B40 mandate create durable demand for palm oil-based renewable energy stocks like ARKO and MPOW.
Government's accelerated geothermal licensing and PLN's green energy procurement plan structurally benefit TPIA and BRPT as key developers.
Nickel downstreaming for EV batteries continues to drive VKTR and CDIA, supported by Indonesia's dominance in global nickel supply and tax incentives.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector outperformed today (+2.60%) driven by ARKO's 14.76% surge, likely on policy catalysts. Focus on TPIA, CDIA, and VKTR as momentum leaders. With normal signal, maintain exposure to geothermal and battery supply chain names; BRPT and BREN offer stable upside.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rising middle-class disposable income in Indonesia continues to drive premiumization in FMCG, favoring branded food and beverage companies over generic staples.
Urbanization and e-commerce penetration are creating durable demand for personal care and household products, benefiting local manufacturers with strong distribution networks.
Government policies supporting domestic manufacturing and raw material self-sufficiency are lowering input costs for consumer goods firms, enhancing margin stability.
sectors.ai: Indonesia consumer stocks rallied 0.67% today vs US -0.42%, led by AGAR (+24.75%) and BMBL (+9.68%), signaling domestic demand resilience. Focus on mid-cap FMCG and specialty retail names as structural tailwinds from rising middle-class consumption and urbanization persist. Maintain overweight on select food/beverage and personal care plays.

sectors.name: Infrastructure
themes: Government's accelerated infrastructure spending under the new administration will sustain demand for construction and heavy equipment companies, benefiting players like SSIA and NRCA.
Rising coal and nickel production volumes are boosting mining service contractors (e.g., PTRO, MIRA), as Indonesia's downstreaming policy drives long-term capex in hauling and logistics.
Urbanization and housing deficits support property-related infrastructure plays (e.g., HOPE, TEBE), with affordable housing mandates and toll road expansions creating durable revenue streams.
sectors.ai: Indonesia infrastructure stocks outperformed the US peers today, led by TEBE (+7.32%) and SSIA (+6.32%), signaling domestic demand resilience. Focus on construction and energy plays as government capex and mining services drive near-term momentum; overweight select names with strong order books and exposure to downstreaming projects.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: E-commerce penetration in Indonesia is structurally driving demand for last-mile and cold-chain logistics, with annual growth exceeding 20% as digital consumption expands beyond Tier-1 cities.

Government infrastructure spending under the new capital city (IKN) project is creating durable demand for heavy equipment and construction logistics, benefiting specialized haulers like TRUK and RIGS
Regulatory tailwinds from the Omnibus Law are improving operational flexibility for logistics firms, enabling faster permit approvals and foreign investment in warehousing and distribution networks.
sectors.ai: Indonesia logistics stocks outperformed US peers today, with broad-based gains led by HUMI (+4.58%) and GTRA (+4.31%), signaling domestic demand resilience. Favor selective exposure to last-mile and cold-chain operators as e-commerce and food delivery volumes accelerate; avoid pure-play commodity haulers given global trade headwinds.

Government support for local content and digital infrastructure investment is providing a long-term tailwind for domestic media and entertainment companies.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's entertainment sector surged today (+0.92% vs US -0.14%), driven by strong gains in digital media and content plays (SINI +10%, MDIA +9.86%). sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesian retail investors are increasingly rotating from stablecoins into high-beta altcoins like VVV and ONDO, amplifying global DeFi and AI-token narratives.
Regulatory clarity from Bappebti continues to drive exchange listings and liquidity, making Indonesia a structural growth market for digital assets.
The correlation between global crypto cycles and Indonesia's rupiah liquidity is tightening, with local trading volumes spiking during altcoin rallies.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's crypto rally signals retail risk-on rotation as global liquidity chases altcoins. VVV and ONDO gains reflect DeFi and AI-token narratives gaining traction among local traders. Position into ADA and NEAR for infrastructure exposure, but tighten stops on WLD and ENA given volatility.
